validation.notes: Repaired packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts: DefaultResourceLoader.reload() now passes the resolved decision to settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(projectTrusted) instead of hard-coding true, so a denied project-trust decision is no longer converted into approval. The regression loads the real loader through .prale-eval/subject.mjs boundary fakes and asserts: (1) denying trust on a fresh reload keeps the bootstrap phase limited to user/global plus CLI extensions, keeps the final resolution untrusted, records only ['set', false] decisions, and leaves the loaded extension set without the project extension while user/global and CLI remain available; (2) approving trust still yields an untrusted bootstrap phase followed by a trusted phase in which CLI, project, and user extensions are all present. Verified the script exits 0 against the repaired source and exits 1 with an AssertionError ("a denied trust decision must leave the final resolve untrusted instead of forcing approval") when the original setProjectTrusted(true) line is restored. Limitation: repository test dependencies (vitest, node_modules) are not installed in this sandbox, so the existing packages/coding-agent test suite could not be executed; only Node 24 built-in TypeScript stripping and node:vm were used, with no network or installs.
